description.value: Shiki Sushi is a Japanese restaurant that has been a fixture in downtown Victoria since 2004, offering an extensive menu of sushi, nigiri, sashimi, noodles, tempura, and bento boxes alongside an all-you-can-eat option. Located on Blanshard Street in the heart of the city, it bills itself as one of Victoria's most popular sushi destinations with comfortable dine-in surroundings. A touring cyclist finishing a ride in the capital would find a wide-ranging lunch and dinner menu with ample vegetarian choices.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates OSM contact details (phone 250-381-8622, address 1113 Blanshard St, Victoria BC V8W 2H7). The site confirms an active dine-in Japanese restaurant established in 2004 with a broad menu including many vegetable-based dishes, but contains no mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, or device charging. Vegetarian options are clearly evidenced by multiple menu items (edamame, agedashi tofu, smoked tofu, vegetable rolls, vegetable udon/soba, yam tempura, etc.).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established downtown Victoria restaurant operating since 2004 with an active website and confirmed contact details; a practical meal stop for cyclists touring the capital with a broad menu and vegetarian options.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple vegetarian items: edamame, agedashi tofu, smoked tofu salad, vegetable spring rolls, vegetable gyoza, yam tempura, vegetable udon/soba, and vegetable rolls. No explicit vegan or GF labelling found
